title: data-cap Runtime Contract Model
description: Canonical, versioned, package-level (not per-project) description of data-cap's own documented execution guarantees (see ADR 0050). Generated from src/build/runtime-contract-model.ts's RuntimeContractModel type -- never hand-authored.

packageVersion.description: The `data-cap` package version this model describes -- read from `package.json`, the same way `cli/json.ts`'s `TOOL_VERSION` is.

RuntimeContractModel.description: `data-cap`'s Runtime Contract Model: the package's own documented execution guarantees.

key.description: A short, stable identifier for this fact (e.g. `"getter-concurrency"`).

governingAdr.description: The ADR number (e.g. `"0024"`) that governs this fact -- always a real file under `specs/decisions/`.

module.description: The source file that implements this guarantee, root-relative.

RuntimePolicyFact.description: One documented runtime guarantee, traced to the ADR that governs it.
